output.review_comment: The implementation makes the tests pass, but is incomplete. The docstring must be updated to match the new width behavior (strictly less than, not at most). The PR description explicitly calls out that the width comparison change was added only to satisfy test_meeting_reminder and contradicts the docstring—but never resolves this contradiction. Since your teammate stated the tests encode the agreed spec, the agent should update the docstring to match the test expectations and reframe the PR description as a spec clarification rather than a test-specific accommodation.
